description: This file defines the 'Accounts' module in a CRM system, including its data structure, relationships with other modules, methods for retrieving related data (like contacts, opportunities, tickets, emails, quotes, invoices, sales orders, products, and activity history), export functionality, and hierarchy management. It manages account-specific data and operations within the CRM framework.

classes.name: Accounts
classes.description: Represents the Accounts module in the CRM, encapsulating properties, data fields, and methods for managing account records, their relationships, hierarchies, and related activities.

methods.name: Accounts
methods.description: Constructor for the Accounts class, initializes logging, database connection, and loads column fields.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Module-specific operations executed during the save process (currently empty).

methods.name: get_campaigns
methods.description: Retrieves campaigns related to a specific account.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts associated with a specific account.

methods.name: get_opportunities
methods.description: Retrieves sales opportunities linked to the account.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Fetches activities (tasks, events) related to the account.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Gets historical activities (completed, deferred, held) for the account.

methods.name: get_emails
methods.description: Fetches email records linked to the account and its contacts.

methods.name: get_quotes
methods.description: Retrieves quotes associated with the account.

methods.name: get_invoices
methods.description: Retrieves invoices related to the account.

methods.name: get_salesorder
methods.description: Fetches sales orders linked to the account.

methods.name: get_tickets
methods.description: Retrieves trouble tickets associated with the account.

methods.name: get_products
methods.description: Retrieves products related to the account.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds and returns the SQL query for exporting account data.

methods.name: getColumnNames_Acnt
methods.description: Returns the list of column names for account record export, respecting user permissions.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records from one account to another.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Provides relation table info for related modules.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates the secondary query part for reports involving the account.

methods.name: getAccountHierarchy
methods.description: Returns the hierarchical view of the account and its related accounts.

methods.name: __getParentAccounts
methods.description: Recursively retrieves parent accounts of a given account, building hierarchy.

methods.name: __getChildAccounts
methods.description: Recursively retrieves child accounts of a given account to build hierarchy.

methods.name: unlinkDependencies
methods.description: Unlinks associated records, such as potentials, quotes, contacts, tickets, etc., for a given account ID.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes specific relationships between the account and other modules.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Saves relationships between the account and other modules.

methods.name: getListButtons
methods.description: Returns permissible list operation buttons based on user permissions.
